how-25-01-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the shells, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-25-01-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the shells, then tap three things you notice.

how-25-01-compare.page: Put the scissors under one tray and the fence under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.
how-25-01-compare.say: Put the scissors under one tray and the fence under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.

how-25-01-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.
how-25-01-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.

how-25-01-det.page: Pick 3 parks, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick its habitat. Predict a living thing you'll find, and watch it appear.
how-25-01-det.say: Pick three parks, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick its habitat. Predict a living thing you'll find, and watch it appear.

how-25-01-partc.page: Draw a national park scene with at least 2 zones, like a marsh and a forest. Label a living thing in one zone, and one action that protects it.
how-25-01-partc.say: Draw a national park scene with at least two zones, like a marsh and a forest. Label a living thing in one zone, and one action that protects it.
